title: Credit Limit, Holds and Releases on Home Delivery Pharmacy Accounts
content:
## Billing desk guidance: holds on a Home Delivery Pharmacy account

**Rule.** Before an order ships, its member charge is added to the current balance due; when the result would exceed the program's credit limit the account is placed on hold with the hold reason balance over limit, unless a payment plan is in good standing and the program exempts orders from balance holds while a plan is in good standing. A card that declines is retried the program's number of automatic retries before the account is placed on hold with the hold reason payment declined; a shipping address that fails verification places it on hold with the hold reason address unverified. The hold is released once its cause is cleared: for balance over limit, when payments bring the balance due plus the held orders' charges to the credit limit or less, or when a payment plan is set up; for payment declined, when a working payment method is recorded and the overdue amount is collected; for address unverified, when a verified address is recorded. A hold may be released only while the account is on hold and only after the recorded cause has been cleared.

Placing an account on hold is the system's doing; releasing a hold is an agent action, taken only on the conditions above as the account records show them (status, hold reason and balance due).

### Hold test for one order

The account is held for balance when the balance due plus the order's member charge is more than the credit limit. A total exactly equal to the credit limit does not trigger a hold.

| Hypothetical case (credit limit 150.00) | Balance due | Order charge | Total | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 120.00 | 30.00 | 150.00 | ships, total not above the limit |
| B | 120.00 | 30.01 | 150.01 | hold, balance over limit |
| C | 120.00 | 30.01 | 150.01 | ships, if a payment plan is in good standing on a program that exempts plan accounts from balance holds |

### Release conditions by hold reason

| Hold reason recorded | Cause cleared when |
|---|---|
| Balance over limit | payments bring the balance due plus the held orders' charges to the credit limit or less, or a payment plan is set up |
| Payment declined | a working payment method is recorded and the overdue amount is collected |
| Address unverified | a verified address is recorded |

### Worked release (hypothetical)

An account with a 200.00 credit limit is on hold for balance over limit with a balance due of 180.00 and one held order of 45.00. The balance plus the held charge is 225.00. A payment of 25.00 brings it to 200.00, which is the credit limit or less, so the cause is cleared; a payment of 24.99 leaves 200.01 and does not clear it.
